title: Bashi na farko: lissafin lye da yin sandunan tsarin sanyi
course_title: Yin Sabulu don Ƙananan Kasuwanci: Sandunan Tsari-Ciwon sanyi da Sabulun Liquid Mai Sauƙi

say: Bashi na farko: lissafin lye da yin sandunan tsarin sanyi.
Wannan bidiyon ne don Module 2 na Yin Sabulu don Kananan Kasuwanci.
Samun adadin lye daidai shine abin da ke sa sabulu lafiya. Yawan caustic soda yana barin mashaya mai tsauri wanda zai iya ƙonewa.

panel.kicker: Me yasa lissafin ke da mahimmanci
panel.heading: Samun lye dama yana kiyaye sabulu lafiya
items: Yawan caustic soda: mai zafi, mashaya mai zafi
Kadan kaɗan: mai maiko, mashaya mai laushi wanda ke tafiya bazuwar
Yi lissafi da hannu, sannan duba cikin SoapCalc

say: Mutane suna kiran samfuran ruwa daban-daban guda biyu. Ana dafa sabulun ruwa na gaskiya daga mai da potassium hydroxide a cikin manna, sannan a shafe shi da ruwan zafi. Duk ƙa'idodin aminci soda caustic suna aiki.

panel.heading: Sabulun ruwa iri biyu
left: Dafa shi zuwa manna, sannan a diluted

say: Wankin keg shine wanki na ruwa da aka yi daga SLES, galibi ana siyarwa azaman texapon. Zaki tsoma shi cikin ruwa ki kwaba shi da gishiri kadan kadan. Gishiri da yawa yana sake yin bakin ciki.
Dukansu na iya zama samfurori masu kyau. Kawai yiwa kowa lakabi da gaskiya.

panel.heading: Sabulun ruwa iri biyu
left: Dafa shi zuwa manna, sannan a diluted

say: Sanya safar hannu da tabarau don hanyoyin biyu.

panel.heading: Dokokin aminci guda uku don samfuran ruwa

cards.d: Manna SLES yana fusatar da idanu da fata. Caustic potash yana buƙatar cikakken amincin lye.
Yi amfani da abin kayyade kayan kwalliya a ƙimar mai siyarwar. Kada ka taba yin formalin.
Bincika cika kwalbar kullun don rabuwa, girgije, wari ko mold.

say: Wasu girke-girke na gida suna ƙara formalin azaman abin adanawa. An rarraba Formaldehyde azaman abu mai haifar da ciwon daji. Yi amfani da madaidaicin abin adana kayan kwalliya maimakon.

say: Don tunawa. Lye shine lokutan nauyin mai ƙimar SAP. Raba da 0.95 don 5% superfat. Koyaushe duba cikin SoapCalc. Haɗa dumi, warke sosai, kuma kar a taɓa amfani da formalin.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Lye = nauyin mai x ƙimar SAP, ga kowane mai
Raba da 0.95 don 5% superfat
Duba lissafin hannun ku a cikin SoapCalc
Haɗa a kimanin 35 zuwa 45 ° C, warke 4 zuwa 6 makonni
Samfuran ruwa suna buƙatar ma'auni mai dacewa

say: Yanzu yi ƙaramin gwajin gwaji tare da cikakken rikodin tsari, ƙididdige girke-girke naku da hannu da a cikin SoapCalc, kuma gwada wanke ruwa mai kilo 1.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
